metrics.name: interactive_intrusion_increase_yoy
metrics.notes: A 75% year-over-year increase in hands-on-keyboard (interactive) intrusions.

metrics.name: ecrime_breakout_time_minutes
metrics.notes: Average time for an eCrime adversary to move laterally from initial compromise was 5 minutes and 29 seconds.

insights: Identity-based attacks are a primary vector, with adversaries exploiting valid credentials. Cloud environments are increasingly targeted.

metrics.name: leak_site_victims_2023
metrics.notes: Number of new victim organizations posted to ransomware leak sites in 2023, a 49% increase from 2022.

metrics.name: moveit_transfer_victim_count
metrics.notes: The MOVEit Transfer vulnerability (CVE-2023-34362) led to over 1,140 publicly posted victims.

insights: Vulnerability exploitation is the top initial access vector for ransomware. Multi-extortion techniques (encryption, data theft, DDoS) are now standard practice.
